SUMMARY: Add a new CompactWithTombstones method to the Compactor interface in prometheus/tsdb to enable tombstone-aware multi-block compaction for Thanos and Mimir. The method accepts context, block metadata slice, and tombstones, returning the ULID of the newly created compacted block.

FILES:
- prometheus/tsdb/compact.go — Add CompactWithTombstones method to the Compactor interface definition
